proc.describe: Your attacks have a chance to burn the target for 40 fire damage.
Your attacks have a chance to grant 30 spell power for 3 turns.
Your damaging spells have a chance to grant 60 attack power for 3 turns.
Your attacks have a chance to steal 30 health from the target.
Your spells have a chance to give you back 60 mana.
Your attacks have a chance to heal you for 60.
Your attacks have a chance to heal you for 40 and grant 60 Strength for 3 turns.
